    Projects

    Dimensione Brama

    A collective combining theatre, music, and dance in innovative performances. Key moments include the release of first album TEATRAL POLITIK participation at Milano Fashion Week for Pecoranera (2022), our concert at the renowned Auditorium Parco della Musica for RETAPE (2023), the artist-in-residency at Carrozzerie n.o.t. for Odiolestate (2024), and participation in the TV show X Factor (2024).

    Subba and the Roots

    A legacy, longest-running since 2013, blending blues and reggae, R&B and soul. We released the album “BRINDA!” (2018) and toured Italy thanks to the Bando Nuovo IMAIE (2019).

    Soloperisoci

    I was session drummer for indie-pop singers and joined Ernesto e i Soci for the tour of their album “Un Giorno Sì Un Giorno No” (2018). We later released “Ingresso Riservato” (2023) under the band name Soloperisoci.
